text: I'm really scared and not sure what to do. I'm a foster parent, the boy staying with us is 5. His temperature is 39.7, I've taken it three times now with two different thermometers and it keeps coming up about the same. I don't think I've ever seen a number that high on a child before. He's got a few itchy insect bites on his legs from when we were at the park, they just look like normal bites to me but I keep going back and looking at them. He's still weeing normally, he's been to the toilet a couple of times tonight. There's been no fit or shaking or jerking, I've been sitting with him the whole time watching. I've given him paracetamol about an hour ago. I'm worried because he's not my own and I have to report things properly and I'm terrified of missing something. Does he need to be seen tonight or can I keep him home and watch him? I'm sorry if this is a lot.
